set.body:
Scope:
Use the portable resource model at both pool-acquisition and task-admission boundaries, complete Slurm pool wiring, and close artifact-producing operation parity.

Acceptance criteria:
- PoolSpec contains a validated homogeneous pilot capacity envelope distinct from lease timing and pilot count.
- The Slurm adapter lowers the pilot envelope once per allocation and records its requested/effective plan.
- Pool manifests or registrations carry typed capacity sufficient for portable admission; opaque scheduler allocation tokens remain evidence only.
- Each task is checked against pilot capacity before publication/claim; an oversized task never executes.
- V1 remains one task per pilot, with no hidden bin packing, fractional accounting, or enforcement claims.
- Local pools model the same capacity and admission behavior.
- Slurm pool lease deadline, readiness, heartbeat, drain, reclaim ladder, retry-safety, epoch fence, and Unknown semantics remain intact.
- Artifact-producing tasks have local batch, local pool, Slurm batch, and Slurm pool outcome parity.
- Wire changes are versioned, hand-coded, canonical, migration-documented, and golden-tested.
- Pool, Parity, artifact, adversarial race, repository-wide, and configured/disposable Slurm acceptance gates pass proportionally.
set.title: SOJ.R4: Add resource-aware Slurm pilot pools and artifact parity
